business_problem: McMillan Shakespeare was managing project demand, resource costs, and timesheets through spreadsheets and legacy tools, which broke formulas, obscured project performance, and made cost forecasting and resource planning increasingly risky.
solution_summary: McMillan Shakespeare centralized portfolio and resource planning on ServiceNow Strategic Portfolio Management so timesheets, demand intake, and allocation decisions could run from one cloud platform instead of brittle spreadsheets. Time Card Management gives every user direct portal access to enter hours, eliminating email-based spreadsheet submissions and letting managers approve data in one place. Resource Management then combines those actuals with allocation views so leaders can spot bottlenecks, project overruns, and capacity gaps early rather than after budgets slip. Demand Management adds scoring and prioritization to new initiatives, linking project value to resource planning and 90-day forecasting sessions. By connecting those layers, MMSG turned portfolio oversight into a real-time decision system that helps PMO leaders align spending with strategy, reduce operational risk, and improve cost control while keeping the door open for broader ITSM and CMDB improvements.

solution_components.name: Strategic Portfolio Management
solution_components.role: Provides the umbrella planning and decision framework for project demand, costs, and priorities.

solution_components.name: Time Card Management
solution_components.role: Captures timesheet actuals directly in the portal instead of through emailed spreadsheets.

solution_components.name: Resource Management
solution_components.role: Shows capacity, allocation, and availability across projects so managers can rebalance work early.

solution_components.name: Demand Management
solution_components.role: Scores and prioritizes new initiatives based on business value and resource impact.

solution_components.name: IT Service Management
solution_components.role: Forms the adjacent ServiceNow foundation that MMSG plans to connect more tightly with SPM over time.

data_flow: Users enter timesheet data directly into the ServiceNow portal, where Time Card Management feeds actuals into Strategic Portfolio Management. Resource Management and Demand Management then combine those actuals with forecasts, priorities, and allocation views so managers can approve work, identify bottlenecks, and correct cost risks before they affect portfolio outcomes.
business_outcome: McMillan Shakespeare cut timesheet entry time by 50%, enabled 100% of timesheet users to enter data directly into the portal, improved forecasting and resource visibility across about 50 concurrent projects, and gave managers early warning of cost overruns and capacity shortages.

evidence_quotes: ServiceNow Strategic Portfolio Management (SPM) was deployed to help the organization respond faster to change by improving the alignment of project investments with strategic priorities.
By using Time Card Management within SPM, 100% of timesheet users can enter data directly into the portal.
Thanks to ServiceNow SPM, it takes less than a minute for users to enter timesheet details, which is 50% faster than before.
By using ServiceNow Demand Management with Resource Management, MMSG can automatically collect, score, and prioritize requests based on the value of the new projects to the business.
With ServiceNow SPM, we have a holistic view of demands and resource availability.
